summary: Tested Indian number formatting (en-IN locale) rollout and new Sale Price/Sale Value columns in Sales Plan Lookup dialog. Sales Plan Lookup dialog fully verified end-to-end: 58 items loaded from OMS, Sale Price (native currency, e.g. 'USD 4.31') and Sale Value (INR) columns render correctly in Indian comma format (e.g. 'INR 1,57,06,329.60'), row expansion shows correct per-customer sub-rows, and the totals footer (data-testid=sales-plan-totals-row) is mathematically exact - verified via direct API sum: qty 571756 -> displayed '5,71,756', value 266755437.69 -> displayed 'INR 26,67,55,437.69'. Backend GET /api/sales-plan confirmed returning real price/currency/total_sale_value_inr/sale_value_inr fields (curl sanity check passed). BOM Explorer and Purchasing Plan formatMoney/formatQty/toLocaleString code reviewed and confirmed using 'en-IN' locale in both files (BomExplorerPage.js lines 535/680/690, PurchasingPlanPage.js lines 54/57). Quantity columns on Purchasing Plan (e.g. '2,36,68,699.29', '50,894.18') visually confirmed rendering Indian grouping correctly. HOWEVER: could not visually verify the money/Value columns and Gross/Net Value stat cards on Purchasing Plan or Std Cost/Ext Cost on BOM Explorer because the live SAP valuation OData endpoint (materialvaluationdata) is currently timing out/unreachable (ConnectTimeoutError, consistently failing for the entire test session from 03:19 to 10:03 UTC per backend logs) - this caused unit_cost=null for all 959 components in the generated plan and 502s on /api/bom/standard-costs. This is a live third-party SAP connectivity issue, unrelated to the Indian-formatting code change, and not something I can fix. Code review of the formatMoney function confirms it would render correctly once real cost data flows through (same toLocaleString('en-IN') function already proven correct via the Sales Plan dialog and quantity columns). Light regression: Admin page (Category Master, Lead Time column, Push to SAP column) loads correctly with no errors.

minor.issue: Live SAP ByD valuation endpoint (my431827.businessbydesign.cloud.sap) is timing out consistently (ConnectTimeoutError, connect timeout=30) throughout the entire test session. This causes standard-costs to return 502 and all components in a generated purchasing plan to have unit_cost=null / value_by_month=null, making Gross Value/Net Purchase Value stat cards and per-row Value columns show 0.00 regardless of the Indian-formatting fix. This is a live infra/SAP-tenant issue, not a regression from this round of changes - the OMS-sourced Sales Plan Lookup (unaffected by this SAP endpoint) worked perfectly.

action_items: No code fix needed for the Indian-formatting feature itself - implementation verified correct via code review + Sales Plan Lookup dialog + quantity columns.

Investigate/monitor SAP ByD valuation endpoint (materialvaluationdata) connectivity - it has been timing out for the full test session, blocking visual confirmation of money formatting on Purchasing Plan stat cards / table Value columns and BOM Explorer Std Cost/Ext Cost columns. Recommend main agent retry BOM Explorer 'Load Standard Costs' and Purchasing Plan generation once SAP tenant connectivity is stable to get a final visual confirmation, though the underlying code is sound.
critical_code_review_comments: formatQty/formatMoney in PurchasingPlanPage.js (lines 54-57) and toLocaleString('en-IN',...) calls in BomExplorerPage.js (lines 535, 680, 690) correctly use en-IN locale - verified producing correct Indian grouping (e.g. 5,71,756 and 26,67,55,437.69) via the Sales Plan Lookup dialog which is unaffected by SAP flakiness.

Sales Plan Lookup totals footer math is exact - manually summed all 58 items' total_qty and total_sale_value_inr via direct API call and it matched the displayed grand totals exactly (571756 and 266755437.69).
Server.py SalesPlanItem/SalesPlanCustomerQty extension with currency/price/total_sale_value_inr/sale_value_inr fields is working correctly end-to-end from OMS to UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for Sales Plan Lookup dialog; unable to visually confirm money formatting on Purchasing Plan/BOM Explorer due to unrelated live SAP valuation endpoint outage
